plugins.name: tk
plugins.description: Own-authored session-flow skills: /tk:kickoff opens a session from the canonical next-steps queue, /tk:wrap-up closes it, /tk:dispatch routes a task to the right execution mechanism, /tk:docs-audit audits docs against the code.

plugins.name: tk-cowork
plugins.displayName: tk-cowork — session flow for Claude Cowork
plugins.description: The kickoff/wrap-up pair rebuilt for knowledge work in Cowork: no git, no test suite; the gate covers irreversible actions (send, share, schedule) and the queue is next-steps.md at the project folder's root.

plugins.name: asr
plugins.description: Transcribes audio Read cannot decode (voice notes, recordings, WhatsApp exports) locally on CPU, so nothing leaves the machine. Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 by default, faster-whisper as the fallback for the languages Parakeet lacks; resumable batches, and a chunked pipeline that survives a small box.

plugins.name: plugin-drift
plugins.description: Read-only drift report across every installed Claude Code plugin, in every marketplace known to this machine: refreshes each catalog, compares installed content against it (commit for git-pinned plugins, file hashes for plugins packaged in the marketplace repo), and pulls changelog highlights for drifted git-pinned plugins. Never applies an update.
